page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores utilizing the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and delivering a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The single-core processing power is relatively weak, as shown by bottom 25% scores in stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, alongside poor single-threaded compression performance. However, the instance leverages its 32 dedicated cores to achieve average multi-core performance in stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached operations remains in the average tier, though the overall Passmark memory score is positioned in the bottom 25%.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2.7xlarge offers a high density of dedicated physical cores and balanced memory allocation without the premium cost of newer generation architectures. This makes it a viable option for parallelizable workloads where multi-core throughput is more critical than raw single-thread speed. Appropriate workloads include multi-threaded software compilation, static web serving, Redis database operations, and moderate multi-threaded data processing tasks.
